messages:
maya: Quick note — I ran an autoscale sim across ~100 tenants and exported the perf curves + cost delta. Need a docs sweep and a tiny SDK snippet update. CSV export here: https://internal.redwood/sim-exports/2156789012.csv

sam: Nice, thanks. What latency SLO did you assume for the sim?

maya: SLO is 150ms p50, p95=320ms. Config used is in the gist; core policy snippet below:
```yaml
policy:
  target_p50: 150
  target_p95: 320
  scale_window: 60
  min_replicas: 1
  max_replicas: 20
  batch_size: 8
```

lee: For the docs we should include a before/after table showing batching + KV-cache impact. Can you also attach tokens/sec vs replicas plots?

maya: Added two plots to PR #3487 (docs/autoscale). PR link: https://gh.redwood/infer/pulls/3487 — key takeaway: ~2.3x cost reduction at p95 when batching+cache is enabled for conversation-style workload.

juan: I can update the SDK example to show the recommended flags. Tentative Python snippet I'll add to the PR: 
```python
client.update_scale_policy('tenant-123', policy={
  'target_p50': 150,
  'target_p95': 320,
  'passiveCache': True,
  'batchSize': 8
})
```
I'll run it against staging and paste results.

chris: Heads up — the handbook link in the PR currently points to /docs/provisioning/reserved.md and returns 404. Should point to /docs/dedicated/reserved-pools.md (or the new reserved-pools migration page).

maya: Good catch, thanks. I'll update the link before merging. Also proposing we add a short migration note about eviction semantics when customers move from shared to reserved pools (sim notes show 5% of tenants hit preemption edge-case).

lee: Agreed — add the migration note and a short bullet on quota impacts for scaling behaviour. That will reduce post-migration surprises.

sam: :thumbsup: Can someone run a quick smoke test of the SDK snippet? I can run a local unit test if necessary.

juan: I ran it on staging briefly — output: `ok - policy accepted, replica_target=3`. I'll paste full logs in the PR comments.

deploy-bot: deploybot: docs site build success for branch docs/autoscale-sweep — preview available at https://staging.docs.redwood/autoscale-3487

maya: Great progress. Action items: juan -> push SDK snippet and logs; chris -> confirm handbook link update; lee -> add migration note + quota paragraph; sam -> sanity-check SLO wording in the intro. I'll merge once PR has those edits. Thanks all! :sparkles:
